mapper.select: select count(*) from report where (deleted = 0 or deleted is null) and (#{status} = 'ALL' or status = #{status})

select r.report_id, r.created_at, r.type, u.name, u.nickname, r.title, r.status, r.content from report r left join user u on r.user_id = u.user_id where (r.deleted = 0 or r.deleted is null) and (#{status} = 'ALL' or r.status = #{status}) order by r.report_id desc limit #{row}, 10

select r.report_id, r.type, r.title, r.content, r.post_type, r.post_id, r.user_id, r.created_at, r.status, r.answer, r.answered_at, u.name, u.nickname from report r left join user u on r.user_id = u.user_id where r.report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.update: update report set answer = #{answer}, answered_at = now(), admin_id = #{adminId}, status = '처리완료' where report_id = #{reportId}
